acceptance_steps.action: Wait for the genuine full local pipeline, postscore preparation and exact-k analysis; root reviews actual ANALYSIS_RECEIPT and OUTPUT_SHA256. No current result is read while preparing these tools.

Create a fresh candidate data directory containing exactly the five whitelisted files copied byte-for-byte from that admitted analysis. Preserve the original eight-entry output manifest; do not rewrite missing CSV/TEX entries.

Copy these code-only tools unchanged to a portable location; supply the root-approved original output-manifest SHA explicitly, and run --replay to a new external directory using only Python standard library.

Require all84 rows and16 groups to match, inspect COVERAGE including each original category, wrong-k non-k qualification,3/3 metrics and any historical-overlap exclusion; no row/metric can be dropped or replaced by zero.

Run the exact public whitelist/schema/path checks and inspect the candidate archive file list. Only own source, protocol, scalar tables, reduced metadata and hashes are permitted; no features,labels,native arrays,raw worker receipts,private paths or third-party algorithm code.

Root reviews the actual replay receipt and any later presentation-only caption/header changes separately; freeze a publication manifest for code and data, then follow the publication workflow under the existing user authorization. Do not alter Resource4 or an existing release silently.
After publication, anonymously download the exact candidate and verify the posted archive/input hashes; rerun from the download if requested. No upload or current real replay is part of preparation.

publication_authorization: Existing user authorization applies; root publishes only after actual evidence acceptance
